text:
"Please tell your friends about us."

Every business says it. Almost nobody acts on it, because the ask is vague and the customer has to do all the work.

Referral asks that work have three parts:
1. Timing: ask on the day the customer is happiest, right after the result
2. A ready message: something they can forward in one tap, not something they have to write
3. Something for both sides: a small benefit for the new customer and for the one who referred them

That's it. No referral software needed.

The businesses that grow quietly through word of mouth usually have this written down and send it every single time.
